newsitem.title: GERMANY: German call money rises on strong demand.
newsitem.headline: German call money rises on strong demand.

text.p: German call money rates firmed on Friday, briefly rising as high as 3.15 percent before moving back down to Thursday's level of 3.05/3.10 percent.
Dealers said rates had been driven up by a strong demand for cash ahead of the weekend.

Effective commercial bank deposits fell to 40.1 billion marks on Thursday from 42.3 billion marks while the average for the month through Thursday fell to 42.9 billion marks from 44.2 billion. Bank borrowings from the Lombard facility were unchanged at about 100 million marks.
The Frankfurt Interbank Overnight Average was 3.10267 percent on Friday, up from 3.07067 percent on Thursday.
